title: Tile set contract (set.json), formatVersion 1; place design A3

ship.description: test: a CC0 stand-in that may be on the public sandbox, credited; yes: ours, or CC0 accepted for release

sourceTile.description: pixel size of a tile in the committed sheets

scale.description: integer nearest-neighbour factor the bake applies; sourceTile * scale = 48

palette.description: file with the colours (indices 48..) and the light tables

spriteSheet.description: PNG holding every prop, decal and canopy sprite

groundPairs.description: the one table of which grounds may meet: the pairs the generator may make; every pair must be drawable from the layers' `lowers` (checked where layers.json is made)

layers.description: terrain layers (place design: terrain-layers-design): per terrain id, one fill and the transparent 16-slot layers (kinds) it draws over lower terrains, or `drawAs` another terrain until its own layers are signed.

tone.description: the lipless tone layer of one terrain: 16 slots, drawn last over uniform tiles of `of`; it has no fill

also.description: further terrain ids that may carry tone: the raised top (cliff), where the generator also keeps the cell two rows below raised, so tone never lands on a face

raised.description: the tone sheet for the raised ground (the cliff terrain's fill): one 4x4 grid, drawn in place of `sheets` on a tile whose four cells are all raised

drawAs.description: terrain id: the terrain this one is drawn as while the set has no layers of its own for it

ground.description: terrain id drawn beneath this terrain's own corners (a layer whose paint has gaps)

sheets.description: one strip per animation frame, each holding n opaque 16 px variants left to right

kind.description: free name (step, flat, beach, bank, rim ...); the paint decides bank vs flat

lowers.description: terrain ids this kind can meet; a lower in no kind's list is refused by the bake (no-edge). The first kind holding any lower of a tile wins

sheets.description: one 4x4 grid of 16 slots in corner order NW*8+NE*4+SW*2+SE per animation frame; slot 0 empty, transparent where the lower shows

full.description: a strip of slot-15 variants, for a terrain with a ground

variants.description: further 16-slot sheets sharing every edge line, one picked per dual tile by hash

tall.description: a tall terrain (the cliff face): keys 1..3, the sheets used when the cell under the bottom left (1), right (2) or both (3) corners is not this terrain; several sheets are picked by hash

wayup.description: per lower terrain id, a 3 x 2 sheet of 16 px tiles for the way up

rect.description: x, y, w, h of the first frame in the sprite sheet; further frames follow to the right at stride w

anchor.description: the foot pixel in rect-local source pixels; a canopy cut from a prop's sprite carries the same foot point in its own coordinates

footprint.description: tile offsets from the entity's cell that block; empty or absent: never blocks

canopy.description: name in the set's canopy table, drawn over the explorer with the cut-out
